text:
sasha: Heads-up — onboarding windfall9b (hf conversion) gave weird generation differences after int4 quant. Noticed in our summarization evals.
ryan: Can you paste the quick eval numbers?
sasha: Sure — baseline fp16 vs int4 (our standard quant) on rouge/latency:```
model        | rouge1 | rouge2 | latency/token
windfall9b-fp16 | 0.42   | 0.19   | 12ms
windfall9b-int4 | 0.34   | 0.14   | 6ms
qwen-compat-int4  | 0.41   | 0.18   | 6.2ms
```
sasha: So ~18% drop on rouge1 vs fp16, bigger than expected. Latency is good but quality regressed.
ekta: Did you run with and without rotary rescaling? We saw phase wrapping issues before when head layouts mismatch.
sasha: Yup — tried keeping rotary scale at model-provided config and also forced our usual sqrt scaling. Both show degradation but slightly better with sqrt.
mattie: Any evidence of token id offset / vocab remapping during conversion? That can cause silent semantic shifts.
sasha: Conversion logs look OK — vocab indices preserved. But I did notice the model had odd head grouping: 8 groups with non-uniform head dims (hybrid-heads). Our kv-cache indexing assumes uniform heads unless flagged. Ryan: That could explain rotary application mismatch. If we pass rotary angles per-head but indexing is off, phase rotates wrong heads. Can you dump a small trace of attention projection shapes?
sasha: Pasted excerpt:```
--- attention.proj_k.shape: (batch, heads=64, seq, head_dim=64)
--- model.config.head_groups: [16,16,16,16]  # actually recorded as 4 groups
--- on-disk protos say head_splits: [8,8,16,32]  # mismatch
```
sasha: So converter normalized the proto to groups of 4x16, but original layout uses uneven splits.
ekta: OK that's a concrete bug in the conversion path — it flattens head_map. If head_map shifts, rotary sin/cos indexing will misapply. Fix: preserve explicit per-head offset and expose head_map to runtime so rotary sinusoid table uses correct mapping.
mattie: In the meantime, can we try a mitigation: run quant with per-head rotary disable for int4 (i.e., fall back to absolute positional proj)? Might restore quality while we fix conversion.
ryan: Worth trying. Also run a quick logit-delta on top tokens between fp16 and int4 to see where probability mass moved — helps triage hallucinations vs style change.
sasha: Will run: 1) re-convert preserving head_map, 2) quick int4 with rotary-disabled, 3) compute token-delta for top-5 tokens on 100 prompts. ETA ~2h.
bench-bot: Started job 1755559999-01: quant-perf/windfall9b-int4-rotary-disabled (queue).
ekta: Also add a small synthetic test: single-token autoregressive continuation for 1k seeds to measure KL divergence per-step (should highlight per-token drift).
sasha: Good call — adding that to the run.
mattie: If conversion fix helps, we should add a conversion unit test: roundtrip head_map + rotary table checks. Add to model-onboard CI.
ryan: Agreed. Once we have the logit-delta output, post it here and we can decide whether rolling a short-term patch (disable per-head rotary in quant runtime) is worth it for Dedicated customers.
sasha: Posting results soon. Thanks all :rocket:
